title: Welcome to Genie Investigation
instruction: Review the sparse starting graph and the 15-credit budget. GraphFrames and Zingg remain available from T2, but the golden path uses precise Genie queries.
hint_text: The graph is incomplete by design. Ask for the missing claim, not for a verdict.

title: Read the query contract
instruction: Open the Genie console and review how scope, quoted cost, expected record classes and remaining balance are shown before execution.
hint_text: Quotes are free. Execution requires explicit confirmation.

title: Quote the ownership query
instruction: Quote the precise query asking who controls the recipient of the 4,800 BSC payment.
hint_text: This query targets one claim: control of the payment recipient.

title: Reveal control and KYC limits
instruction: Confirm and execute the ownership query.
hint_text: Corporate Registry identifies Vera; the null KYC owner field only describes an incomplete source.

title: Interpret null correctly
instruction: Classify the null beneficial-owner field as UNKNOWN_IN_SOURCE rather than NO_OWNER.
hint_text: A missing value is not a negative fact.

title: Quote the chronology query
instruction: Quote a query that normalizes and orders both the legitimate comparison invoice and GI-404.
hint_text: Comparing one valid timezone crossing prevents overgeneralizing from date labels.

title: Build the normalized timeline
instruction: Run the chronology query and open the normalized timeline.
hint_text: GI-401 remains valid; GI-404 is paid before file creation and approval.

title: Classify both timelines
instruction: Mark GI-401 as VALID_TIMEZONE_CROSSING and GI-404 as IMPOSSIBLE_SOURCE_CHRONOLOGY.
hint_text: A claimed document date is weaker than a repository creation timestamp.

title: Quote the evidence-coverage query
instruction: Ask for the contract and work products supporting GI-404, including archive coverage.
hint_text: Ask for both the result and the limits of the search.

title: Reveal missing and partial evidence
hint_text: Unavailable and partial evidence increases uncertainty but does not prove nonexistence.

title: Record the evidence limits
instruction: Record that the contract is unavailable and the partial archive returned no match without claiming that no service ever existed.
hint_text: State only what the source can support.

title: Quote the conflict query
instruction: Ask Genie to compare the witness statements and access records around the approval.
hint_text: The query should request contradictions and unresolved gaps, not a guilty name.

title: Compare statements and system records
instruction: Run the conflict query and review the returned provenance.
hint_text: Milo’s claim conflicts with access control and the vendor-admin session.

title: Protect Tara and preserve uncertainty
instruction: Protect Tara, set confidence to HIGH and record residual uncertainty about the unrecorded conversation and unavailable camera.
hint_text: A strong conclusion does not require pretending every detail is known.

title: Review an inefficient query
instruction: Quote the broad “find anything else suspicious” query, review its six-credit cost and decline it.
hint_text: No-result executions are charged. Precision protects both budget and reasoning.

title: Pin the complete evidence
instruction: Add control, chronology, source-provenance, evidence-limit and protected-actor evidence to the case file.
hint_text: The file must explain both what is proven and what remains unknown.

title: Submit the qualified conclusion
instruction: Submit Vera Vizsla as primary culprit, classify Moonlit Advisory as the fraud vehicle, protect Tara and retain high-confidence residual uncertainty.
hint_text: Submission is free and becomes immutable.

title: Review query efficiency
instruction: Review how query scope, no-result charging, null semantics, chronology and uncertainty affected the score.
hint_text: The optimal path uses four precise Genie runs and leaves three credits.
